name: io.github.slate-rehm/unified-obsidian-mcp
title: Unified Obsidian MCP
description: MCP server for Obsidian plugin development: live app automation over CDP, Playwright browser tools, telemetry, and dev-cycle workflows.

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_CDP_URL
environmentVariables.description: CDP HTTP endpoint for Playwright attach (default http://127.0.0.1:9222)

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_VAULT
environmentVariables.description: Default vault name for CLI calls

environmentVariables.name: UOB_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Server log level on stderr: debug, info, warn, error

environmentVariables.name: UOB_SCREENSHOT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for screenshots and snapshot artifacts

environmentVariables.name: UOB_CLI_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Timeout for a single Obsidian CLI invocation
